summary.name: Tambourine
summary.one_liner: Tambourine is an open-source, customizable AI voice dictation platform that works across apps and lets you choose your own speech-to-text and LLM models.
use_cases: running private local voice dictation with Whisper and Ollama
summary.what_it_does: Tambourine is an open-source platform for AI voice dictation that works in any app. Users can pick speech-to-text (STT) and LLM models, using cloud providers or running fully local with Whisper and Ollama. Formatting behavior is controlled by customizable prompts, which implement default features such as a personal dictionary for technical terms, backtrack corrections triggered by phrases like "actually" or "scratch that", and smart list formatting. The page also lists coming-soon context-aware features such as app-dependent formatting, selection commands, and voice shortcuts. It offers a self-hosted option that is free but requires setup, and a hosted service that is waitlisted.
notable: Models and prompts are fully swappable, including fully local Whisper plus Ollama setup
Backtrack corrections and list formatting are implemented as editable prompts
Listed in awesome-mac under Voice-to-Text as open source and freeware
caveats: Hosted service is waitlist-only at the time of the page; self-hosting requires some setup
Context-awareness features (app-dependent formatting, selection commands, voice shortcuts) are listed as coming soon
Platforms other than the web page are not named on the page
